create_loss_metrics: create a LossMetrics instance to track training loss with a configurable window size
update_loss_metrics: update the LossMetrics object with a new loss tensor after each training iteration
log_loss_metrics: log the current local lifetime and window loss metrics to the console and TensorBoard
update_global_metrics: aggregate loss metrics across distributed workers using all_reduce for global averages
log_global_metrics: log the aggregated global lifetime and window loss metrics across all distributed workers
